decisions.reason: A burner component for the firm's core radiant heater line supports the established business and costs little to keep, though its low website visibility suggests it may be folded into other products.
Electric infrared panel heaters fit the electrification trend and decarbonization demand, and the product has its own website page.
Halogen infrared heaters serve spot and outdoor heating niches that match the firm's customer base, so the product is worth keeping despite moderate competition.
An industrial electric hall heater is close to the core offer and meets demand for low-carbon heating of large halls.
The hydrogen-capable dark heater is a strategic flagship tied to the firm's lower-carbon direction and is already in real-world operation.
